title: Rebased Numbers
description: Changes the radix (or base) of numbers in the inventory
body:
# Rebased Numbers
A simple mod that changes the radix (or base) of numbers in the inventory

## Features:
- Supports bases 2-32
  - base16
  - base32
  - base32hex
  - Crockford's Base32
- Shows in all inventory management:
  - Attack damage and speed
  - Item durability
  - Potion stats
  - etc.

## Language Support:
- English: 100%
- Greek: 100% - (Thank you to my friend `.mr.lenny` on Discord)

## Planned Features:
- Portuguese (Brazil)

## Know bugs/issues:
None, so far
